description: Machine-readable checklist verifying all simulation readiness criteria are met.

criteria.name: Repository forensic audit exists
criteria.evidence: Audit file contains KEEP/QUARANTINE/UNPROVEN/REMOVE classifications

criteria.name: Existing schemas reused wherever possible
criteria.evidence: AUTOMATED_INVENTION_CANDIDATE extends EvidenceItem schema structure; epistemic states reuse existing ontology

criteria.name: AUTOMATED_INVENTION_CANDIDATE contract is explicit
criteria.evidence: Schema defines all 22 required fields including device, failure_mode, target_constraint, observed_phenomenon, source_mechanisms, exact_evidence_spans, source_identifiers, mechanism, cross_domain_connection, proposed_intervention, expected_causal_effect, falsification_test, known_alternatives, prior_art_search_record, prior_art_coverage, adversarial_results, provenance, model_prompt_hashes, source_hashes, searched_universe_version, epistemic_state

criteria.name: SimulationRequest contract exists
criteria.evidence: Schema defines geometry_requirements, materials, operating_conditions, loads, boundary_conditions, environmental_conditions, failure_mode, predicted_mechanism, predicted_measurable_outcome, baseline_control, success_criterion, falsification_criterion, uncertainty, missing_parameters, provenance

criteria.name: SimulationResult contract exists
criteria.evidence: Schema defines result_id, request_reference, engine_info, job_status, completion_timestamp, outputs, provenance with hash verification

criteria.name: Simulation adapter interface exists but has no fake solver
criteria.evidence: Abstract base class SimulationAdapter with submit/status/retrieve/validate methods; NotImplementedAdapter raises NotImplementedError preventing accidental use

criteria.name: Missing-parameter blocking works
criteria.evidence: Fixture B correctly blocked with SIMULATION_BLOCKED_MISSING_PARAMETERS; test_fixture_b_incomplete() passes

criteria.name: Non-falsifiable blocking works
criteria.evidence: Fixture C correctly blocked with SIMULATION_BLOCKED_NON_FALSIFIABLE; test_fixture_c_non_falsifiable() passes

criteria.name: Unsupported assumption blocking works
criteria.evidence: Fixture D correctly blocked with SIMULATION_BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_ASSUMPTION; test_fixture_d_unsupported_assumption() passes

criteria.name: Complete fixture reaches SIMULATION_READY
criteria.evidence: Fixture A submitted successfully with SIMULATION_READY status; test_fixture_a_complete() passes

criteria.name: All tests pass
criteria.evidence: 6/6 tests passed: fixture_a_complete, fixture_b_incomplete, fixture_c_non_falsifiable, fixture_d_unsupported_assumption, validation_result, provenance_chain

criteria.name: Provenance survives discovery → invention → simulation request
criteria.evidence: test_provenance_chain() verifies candidate_id referenced in request, candidate_hash in provenance, source_hashes preserved

criteria.name: No existing prior-art artifacts modified
criteria.evidence: a2_output/p01/, prior_art_forensic/, corpus_v2/ directories unchanged; prior-art thresholds not modified

criteria.name: No TEE code enters active path
criteria.evidence: TEE mechanisms remain quarantined; no TEE operators in simulation readiness layer

criteria.name: Baseline/control structure defined
criteria.evidence: baseline_control object requires description, reference_design, baseline_performance; comparison schema includes dependent_variable, baseline_value, intervention_value, delta, improvement_direction

criteria.name: Future state machine defined but blocked
criteria.evidence: Epistemic states include SIMULATION_READY, SIMULATION_SUBMITTED, SIMULATION_COMPLETE, SIMULATION_SURVIVOR, EXTERNALLY_TESTABLE but AUTOMATED_INVENTION_CANDIDATE remains terminal state

criteria.name: Invention portfolio schema supports thousands of candidates
criteria.evidence: Portfolio schema includes candidates array with summary_statistics; tracks discovery→invention→prior-art→adversarial→simulation→external_validation→commercial_disposition pipeline

criteria.name: Commercial disposition field defined
criteria.evidence: commercial_disposition enum: UNREVIEWED, PATENT_REVIEW, LICENSE_CANDIDATE, ACQUISITION_CANDIDATE, INTERNAL_DEVELOPMENT, REJECTED

criteria.name: Commercial handoff metadata preserved
criteria.evidence: commercial_metadata includes evidence_package_hash, technical_differentiation, expected_performance_delta, regulatory_category, likely_buyer_categories, licensing_readiness, unresolved_risks

criteria.name: No fake simulation outputs created
criteria.evidence: NotImplementedAdapter raises NotImplementedError; no mock results generated; fixtures contain only request-level data

criteria.name: No commercial simulation websites scraped
criteria.evidence: No web scraping code; adapter interface only defines method signatures

criteria.name: No physics parameters invented
criteria.evidence: SIMULATION_BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_ASSUMPTION gate prevents silent parameter invention; Fixture D demonstrates blocking of assumed values

criteria.name: No new discovery algorithm added
criteria.evidence: Simulation readiness layer operates on existing A2 output; no new discovery logic

criteria.name: No new evidence ontology created
criteria.evidence: Extends existing EvidenceItem schema; reuses epistemic state machine
